This change updates internal event tracking and integrates with the emitter's `once` functionality. Scheduled events are now one-time by default unless repeating is specified.

Registration processes these attributes instead of relying on global state. Removes unused imports and simplifies method signatures by removing the need_self parameter, which was only relevant for internal decorator use.
